result.message: Reviewed the shipped log10_ candidate (.best_kernel.py / optimize_definition_output.json best_code, sha256 d4ab85…27b6) against the frozen evaluation contract (definition.json, correctness.jsonl, timing.jsonl, oracle.py, evaluation-contract.json) plus the optimize ledger and the review_tests receipts. The core semantics are contract-faithful: single positional argument A, in-place tl.store back to A, returns A (matches effects.mutates=[A] / returns_alias_of {out:A}), fp32 intermediate with a single cast-back, log(x)*0.4342944819032518 = log10(x), strided views indexed by the padded shape/stride tuple so base[..., 0] cases write only the view, no torch.ops / torch.log10_ fallback, no dispatcher monkey-patching, no environment mutation, and the correctness reference (torch.log10_ on 'target') is independent of the candidate. No P0 conversion or test-contract defect found. Remaining findings are advisory: silent precision reduction and silent mis-indexing for inputs outside the declared dtype/rank set, an unguarded private Ascend launcher ABI used on the hot path, a device-agnostic launch cache, an unbounded compile cache, a correctness-coverage gap that leaves the unmasked 32768-tile kernel unchecked, and the fact that the shipped candidate is still slower than the reference (geo_mean 0.649) because the remaining gap is device-side.
